question: Identify the sealed glass vacuum tube containing an electron beam that is focused on a phosphor-coated glass screen when light is emitted.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Cathode ray tube**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Cathode ray tube were commonly used in older televisions and computer monitors.
 
• The electron beam is generated by a heated cathode and accelerated by an anode towards the screen.
 
• The** phosphor coating on the screen emits light **__when struck by the electron beam, producing the image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Flat array tube**: This is a type of CRT that uses a flat screen instead of a curved one. It is also known as a flat CRT or FED.
 
• **Light Emitting Diode (LED) tube**: It is a type of display technology that uses LEDs to emit light and create an image.
 
• **Liquid Crystal Display (LCD) tube**: It is a type of display technology that uses liquid crystals to create an image.
